# GeographicScatter

`import { GeographicScatter } from '@a3d/a3d-components/map'`

经纬度散点。借用已加载的地图，自己管理透明画布；尺寸单位为CSS像素。

## Example

```ts
const points = new GeographicScatter(map, {data: [{id: 'event', lng: 121.5, lat: 31.24}]});
points.setOptions({pointRadius: 4});
points.dispose();
```
